PART I
Item 1. Business
XYZ Corporation manufactures industrial equipment for construction and mining customers worldwide. The Company operates through three segments and sells primarily through independent dealers. The Company's products are sold in more than 190 countries and it competes on the basis of product performance, dealer support and total cost of ownership.
Item 1A. Risk Factors
Our business is cyclical and depends on capital spending in construction, mining and energy, which can decline sharply during economic downturns. Commodity prices, interest rates and government infrastructure spending all affect demand for our products. Supply chain disruptions could increase costs and delay deliveries to customers.
